name: monopo saigon
mood: Monochrome editorial gallery floating over one liquid iridescent hero atmosphere, with monumental Roobert typography, sharp content corners, full pill buttons, and patient motion.

obsidian.role: Primary text, SVG strokes, overlay fills, borders, and dark inverse bands.

paper.role: Main canvas, inverse labels, and high-contrast text on dark surfaces.

inkstone.role: Footer body copy and softened black reading blocks.

slatePill.role: Filled neutral button background for consent and utilitarian confirmations.

feltGray.role: Muted helper text, addresses, legal copy, and receding annotations.

pewter.role: Secondary mid-tone neutral for hover or muted state layers.

ashMist.role: Disabled states, low-contrast surfaces, and quiet grayscale layers.

iridescentFade.role: Hero media atmosphere only. Never use this as a UI fill.

rules: Use Roobert-style type across navigation, hero, body, project lists, and footer.
Use Raleway only as a rare heading accent.
Use system-ui only for tiny labels, cookie copy, and fine print.
Do not use heavy display weights above 45px.
Use very tight line heights at display sizes.

components.name: Ghost Pill Button - Dark Surface
components.recipe: Transparent fill, 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.3) border, Paper text, 75px radius, Roobert 16px/400, 11px by 33px padding.

components.name: Ghost Pill Button - Light Surface
components.recipe: Transparent fill, 1px Obsidian border, Obsidian text, 75px radius, Roobert 16px/400, 11px by 33px padding.

components.name: Filled Neutral Pill
components.recipe: Slate Pill fill, Paper text, 1px Paper border, 75px radius, used only for consent or utility confirmations.

components.name: Underline-Free Text Link
components.recipe: No background, no border, no underline, 0px radius, Roobert 12-16px, color flips by surface.

components.name: Hero Display Headline
components.recipe: Roobert 225px/400, Paper text, centered over full-viewport iridescent media.

components.name: Project List Row
components.recipe: Transparent background, sharp image, no card surface, no shadow, project title below in Roobert 16-18px.

components.name: Top Navigation Bar
components.recipe: Fixed transparent 66px bar, wordmark left, locale center, menu right, no fill and no shadow.

components.name: Rotating Scroll Indicator
components.recipe: Circular text SVG badge, slow continuous rotation, black or white depending on surface.

do: Let a 225px Roobert display headline own the hero.
Keep all UI colors in black, white, and gray.
Reserve the iridescent gradient for hero media only.
Use 75px radius exclusively for buttons and tags.
Keep cards, images, inputs, and links at 0px radius.
Use weight 300 at 78px for quiet editorial headlines.
dont: Do not introduce a chromatic UI color.
Do not use gradients in buttons, badges, cards, or controls.
Do not use border radii between 1px and 74px.
Do not use heavy display weights above 45px.
Do not center-align body copy in lists, addresses, or project descriptions.
Do not use Raleway for body or navigation.
Do not fill every section with imagery.

imagery.style: One full-viewport liquid iridescent hero texture, followed by sharp editorial project photography.
rules: Use the iridescent gradient only as hero media.
Keep project images sharp-cornered and unframed.
Avoid decorative icon systems and illustration.
Avoid repeated gradients outside the hero.

layout.structure: Centered 1078px editorial container with full-bleed hero and dark inverse bands.
layout.navigation: Transparent fixed 66px top bar with left wordmark, centered locale switcher, and right menu stack.
layout.sectionRhythm: 46px section gaps with asymmetric text-image editorial pacing.
